kiana-void.name: Kiana Kaslana (Void Drifter)
kiana-void.title: Void Drifter
kiana-void.bioSub: The girl who carries the will of the Void.
kiana-void.description: Kiana in her Void Drifter battlesuit, wielding the power of the Void. She is a fierce warrior who fights for humanity.

features.title: Void Power
features.desc: Deals Physical DMG with the power of the Void, capable of teleporting.

features.title: Combo
features.desc: Her combo attacks deal additional Void damage.

bioContent: Kiana's Void Drifter battlesuit represents her acceptance of the Void within her. She uses this power to protect her friends.
She is a symbol of hope for humanity.

skills.name: Void Slash
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Void Shift
skills.desc: Teleports to a target and deals Physical DMG equal to 200% of ATK.

skills.name: Void Burst
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 600% of ATK to all enemies.

kiana-flamescion.name: Kiana Kaslana (Herrscher of Flamescion)
kiana-flamescion.title: Herrscher of Flamescion
kiana-flamescion.bioSub: The girl who inherited the will of the flame.
kiana-flamescion.description: Kiana's ultimate form as the Herrscher of Flamescion, wielding the power of fire and the legacy of Himeko.

features.title: Flame DMG
features.desc: Deals massive fire damage, excelling in sustained combat.

features.title: Herrscher Power
features.desc: Unlocks her true Herrscher form, increasing all stats.

bioContent: Kiana Kaslana is a carefree girl who hides a deep pain. She was separated from her father at a young age and raised by the Schicksal organization.
As she uncovers the truth about the Honkai and her own heritage, she becomes a symbol of hope for humanity.

skills.name: Blazing Strike
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Flame Charge
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to 250% of ATK to all enemies, igniting them for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Finality
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to 600% of ATK to all enemies, and grants Herrscher form for 10 seconds.

mei-thunder.name: Raiden Mei (Herrscher of Thunder)
mei-thunder.title: Herrscher of Thunder
mei-thunder.bioSub: The silent swordswoman with a storm within.
mei-thunder.description: Raiden Mei is a gentle girl who wields the power of lightning. She is a skilled swordswoman and a loyal friend to Kiana.

features.title: Lightning DMG
features.desc: Deals high lightning damage with quick attacks.

features.title: Sakura's Grace
features.desc: Increases attack speed and crit rate when in Herrscher form.

bioContent: Mei was once a normal girl who was forced to become a Herrscher. She struggles to control her power, but finds strength in her bonds with Kiana and Bronya.
Her calm demeanor hides a fierce determination to protect those she loves.

skills.name: Lightning Slash
skills.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Thunder Call
skills.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to 200% of ATK to all enemies, with a 70% chance to stun for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Herrscher's Wrath
skills.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to 500% of ATK to all enemies, and enters Herrscher form for 12 seconds.

bronya-reason.name: Bronya Zaychik (Herrscher of Reason)
bronya-reason.title: Herrscher of Reason
bronya-reason.description: Bronya is a genius hacker and a powerful Herrscher of Reason. She uses her skills to protect her friends and fight against the Honkai.

features.title: Mecha Tech
features.desc: Uses powerful mecha battlesuits to dominate the battlefield.

features.title: Hacking
features.desc: Can disable enemy abilities and increase ally damage.

bioContent: Bronya was once a soldier of the Soviet Union, but after a traumatic event, she became a loyal friend to Kiana and Mei.
As the Herrscher of Reason, she can create any weapon she imagines, making her a versatile fighter.

skills.name: Mecha Strike
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Project Bunny
skills.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 200% of ATK to all enemies, with a 60% chance to reduce enemy DEF by 20%.

skills.name: Reason Unleashed
skills.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 450% of ATK to all enemies, and summons Project Bunny to assist for 10 seconds.

bronya-silverwing.name: Bronya Zaychik (Silverwing: N-EX)
bronya-silverwing.title: Silverwing
bronya-silverwing.description: Bronya's Silverwing battlesuit is a state-of-the-art mecha that uses ice-based attacks. It represents the pinnacle of Schicksal's engineering.

features.title: Ice DMG
features.desc: Deals Ice damage with AoE attacks.

features.title: Shield
features.desc: Grants a shield to herself and boosts attack.

bioContent: The Silverwing battlesuit was designed by Bronya herself, incorporating her experiences as the Herrscher of Reason. It is a testament to her genius.
She uses it to protect her friends and defeat the Honkai.

skills.name: Ice Bolt
skills.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Frozen Shield
skills.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to 180% of ATK to all enemies and grants a shield to Bronya equal to 30% of ATK.

skills.name: Silverwing Blast
skills.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to 400% of ATK to all enemies and freezes them for 3 seconds.

seele-stygian.name: Seele Vollerei (Stygian Nymph)
seele-stygian.title: Stygian Nymph
seele-stygian.bioSub: The girl who dances between worlds.
seele-stygian.description: Seele's Stygian Nymph battlesuit allows her to control quantum energy. She moves through reality like a shadow.

features.title: Quantum DMG
features.desc: Deals Quantum damage with high mobility.

features.title: Sea of Quanta
features.desc: Can phase through enemy attacks.

bioContent: Seele is a gentle girl who carries the weight of a dark past. She is inseparable from the dark personality known as 'Dark Seele'.
Her Stygian Nymph battlesuit allows her to harness the power of the Sea of Quanta.

skills.name: Quantum Slash
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Phantom Shift
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 200% of ATK to all enemies, and phasing through attacks.

skills.name: Abyss Echo
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 500% of ATK to all enemies and creates a quantum rift that deals additional damage.

seele-rebirth.name: Seele Vollerei (Herrscher of Rebirth)
seele-rebirth.title: Herrscher of Rebirth
seele-rebirth.bioSub: The one who brings life to the dead.
seele-rebirth.description: Seele's Herrscher of Rebirth form gives her the power to revive the dead and control quantum energy. She is a formidable force.

features.title: Quantum DMG
features.desc: Deals massive Quantum damage.

features.title: Rebirth
features.desc: Can revive fallen allies under certain conditions.

bioContent: Seele's true power awakens as the Herrscher of Rebirth. She can manipulate quantum energy to revive the dead and reshape reality.
She is a force of nature, but still retains her kind heart.

skills.name: Quantum Burst
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Rebirth Wave
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 220% of ATK to all enemies and heals allies for 20% of damage dealt.

skills.name: Eternal Return
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 600% of ATK to all enemies and revives one fallen ally with 50% HP.

fu-hua-sentience.name: Fu Hua (Herrscher of Sentience)
fu-hua-sentience.title: Herrscher of Sentience
fu-hua-sentience.bioSub: The warrior who masters the mind.
fu-hua-sentience.description: Fu Hua is the Herrscher of Sentience, a master of martial arts and mental manipulation. She fights to protect humanity.

features.title: Sentience
features.desc: Manipulates enemies' minds and deals Physical damage.

features.title: Martial Arts
features.desc: High speed combos and critical hits.

bioContent: Fu Hua is a legendary warrior who has lived for thousands of years. She is a master of martial arts and the Herrscher of Sentience.
She fights to protect humanity from the Honkai, using her mental powers to outsmart her enemies.

skills.name: Fist of the Phoenix
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Mind Over Matter
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 200% of ATK to all enemies and reduces their ATK by 20% for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Sentience Unleashed
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 500% of ATK to all enemies and increases all allies' CRIT Rate by 20% for 10 seconds.

fu-hua-phoenix.name: Fu Hua (Phoenix)
fu-hua-phoenix.title: Phoenix
fu-hua-phoenix.description: Fu Hua's Phoenix battlesuit channels her inner fire, dealing powerful Pyro damage. She is a force of nature.

features.title: Fire DMG
features.desc: Deals Fire damage with AoE attacks.

features.title: Rebirth
features.desc: Gains a second life when defeated.

bioContent: Fu Hua's Phoenix battlesuit represents her mastery over fire. She fights with grace and fury, burning away the darkness.
She is a symbol of hope and resilience.

skills.name: Flame Kick
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Phoenix Wing
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to 180% of ATK to all enemies and applies Burn for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Rebirth Flame
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to 350% of ATK to all enemies and revives Fu Hua with 20% HP if she is defeated.

theresa-celestial.name: Theresa Apocalypse (Celestial Hymn)
theresa-celestial.title: Celestial Hymn
theresa-celestial.description: Theresa is a kind-hearted leader of Schicksal. Her Celestial Hymn battlesuit uses holy powers to smite evil.

features.title: Hymn
features.desc: Buffes allies and deals Physical damage.

features.title: Shield
features.desc: Protects allies with holy shields.

bioContent: Theresa is the principal of St. Freya Academy and a powerful Valkyrie. She is known for her compassion and her unwavering faith.
She uses her holy powers to protect the innocent.

skills.name: Holy Note
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Divine Shield
skills.desc: Grants a shield to all allies equal to 20% of DEF for 5 seconds and increases their ATK by 15%.

skills.name: Celestial Chant
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 300% of ATK to all enemies and heals all allies for 30% of ATK.

rita-starchasm.name: Rita Rossweisse (Starchasm Nyx)
rita-starchasm.title: Starchasm Nyx
rita-starchasm.description: Rita is an S-rank Valkyrie with a mysterious past. Her Starchasm Nyx battlesuit wields the power of the void.

features.title: Quantum DMG
features.desc: Deals Quantum damage with speed and precision.

features.title: Void
features.desc: Can reduce enemy resistance and increase her own damage.

bioContent: Rita is a refined and elegant Valkyrie who serves Schicksal. She is loyal to the Overseer and is a master of void-based combat.
She is always calm and composed, even in the heat of battle.

skills.name: Void Slice
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Nyx Shift
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 200% of ATK to all enemies, with a 50% chance to reduce enemy DEF by 20%.

skills.name: Starless Night
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 500% of ATK to all enemies and reduces their resistance by 30% for 8 seconds.

rita-umbral.name: Rita Rossweisse (Umbral Rose)
rita-umbral.title: Umbral Rose
rita-umbral.description: Rita's Umbral Rose battlesuit focuses on melee combat and physical damage, using her scythe to cut down enemies.

features.title: Physical DMG
features.desc: Deals Physical damage with a scythe.

features.title: Rose's Grace
features.desc: Increases ATK and CRIT Rate when dodging.

bioContent: Rita's Umbral Rose battlesuit is a graceful yet deadly combat style. She wields a scythe with deadly precision.
She is known for her elegance and efficiency in battle.

skills.name: Scythe Slash
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Rapid Rose
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 180% of ATK to all enemies and increases CRIT Rate by 15% for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Umbral Finale
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 400% of ATK to all enemies and increases ATK by 20% for 10 seconds.

durandal-dea.name: Durandal (Dea Anchora)
durandal-dea.title: Dea Anchora
durandal-dea.description: Durandal is an S-rank Valkyrie who wields the power of the Divine Key. Her Dea Anchora battlesuit is the pinnacle of Schicksal's technology.

features.title: Divine Power
features.desc: Deals Physical damage with divine energy.

features.title: Shield
features.desc: Provides shields and boosts damage.

bioContent: Durandal is one of the most powerful Valkyries in Schicksal. She carries the burden of leadership and fights with unwavering resolve.
Her Dea Anchora battlesuit is named after the goddess of justice.

skills.name: Divine Strike
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Anchora Shield
skills.desc: Grants a shield to all allies equal to 25% of DEF and deals Physical DMG equal to 150% of ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: Goddess's Judgement
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to 600% of ATK to all enemies and increases all allies' ATK by 30% for 15 seconds.

elysia-ego.name: Elysia (Herrscher of Human: Ego)
elysia-ego.title: Herrscher of Human: Ego
elysia-ego.bioSub: The girl who became a legend.
elysia-ego.description: Elysia is the Herrscher of Human: Ego, a powerful Valkyrie who fights for the freedom of humanity.

features.title: Imaginary DMG
features.desc: Deals Imaginary damage with graceful attacks.

features.title: Ego
features.desc: Increases damage based on her own HP.

bioContent: Elysia is a legendary figure who sacrificed herself to save humanity. Her Ego battlesuit represents the best of humanity.
She is a symbol of hope and selflessness.

skills.name: Ego Strike
skills.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 100% of ATK to a single enemy.

skills.name: Ego Burst
skills.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 220% of ATK to all enemies and increases damage by 10% for each 10% HP lost.

skills.name: Final Ego
skills.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 550% of ATK to all enemies and revives all fallen allies with 30% HP.
